notes.title: We Care What You Think!
notes.notes:
Sports Mogul is a small company that loves sports, loves our customers, and truly values your feedback. This relationship is the reason that I get out of bed every day, and the reason that I've turned down offers from bigger companies.

If you have a bug report or complaint, please make us aware of it through support@sportsmogul (or cjd@sportsmogul.com or connor@sportsmogul.com). As long as you aren't a jerk about it, we'll treat your feedback seriously and do what we can to make the improvements that you are asking for -- in many cases, we can release a patch or roster correction within 48 hours.

Thanks!
Clay

notes.title: Trading Cards Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
At this time, Steam has strict rules and guidelines for releasing Trading Cards with games, so we will not be able to release the special assets with the game right away.

Instead, we will be able to release them once the game has been out on the marketplace for a few days, so expect the Trading Cards to be available somewhat soon!

Assets to be included:

1) Personalized Profile Backgrounds, sporting sleek football designs.
2) Trading Cards from the popular "Masters of the Gridiron" football card game.
3) Player Badges, including a champion badge.
4) Emoticons to collect for the ultimate fan.

We look forward to releasing these once we can, and hope you all enjoy the new features in this Steam specific version of Football Mogul 18!

Thanks!
Sports Mogul, Inc.
